scenes.say: Picture this. It's a cloudy, rainy week.
Are your solar panels doing anything at all?
Yes. On cloudy days, panels still make about ten to twenty-five percent of their clear-sky output.
And here's the surprise. Cold weather actually improves efficiency. Heat is what reduces output.

lines: within a day or two of sun.
scenes.say: Snow usually slides off tilted panels within a day or two of sunshine. Don't climb on the roof to clear it.
What really matters is annual production, and installers size systems using decades of local weather data.
